Introduction

Sung Si-kyung is a South Korean singer, entertainer, and TV host. Since his debut in 2001, he has released eight Korean studio albums and two Japanese studio albums. Sung Si-kyung has also been a prominent figure on various South Korean variety shows, such as 2 Days & 1 Night, Witch Hunt, Non-Summit, Duet Song Festival, Vocal War: God's Voice, Battle Trip, The Voice of Korea 2020, and On & Off.
